mutability_classes.immutable: cannot change; never offered as advice
mutability_classes.verifiable: borrower can change AND lender can verify -> allowed recourse lever
mutability_classes.gameable: easy to window-dress -> excluded from advice, watched by trust checks
mutability_classes.derived: computed from other features; recompute after any lever change

monotone_pd_convention: +1: PD must not decrease when feature increases; -1: PD must not increase; 0: unconstrained

features.name: bureau_score
features.label: Credit bureau score
features.reason_risk: Bureau score is low or missing (thin credit file) — lenders cannot verify credit history.

features.name: collateral_value_ratio
features.label: Collateral cover
features.reason_risk: Collateral covers only {value:.1%} of the loan — insufficient security for the lender.

features.name: vintage_months
features.label: Business age
features.reason_risk: The business is only {value:.0f} months old — a shorter track record raises repayment uncertainty.

features.name: gst_filing_regularity
features.label: GST filing regularity
features.reason_risk: GST returns were filed on time only {value:.0%} of the last 12 months — filing delays signal weak financial discipline.
features.advice: File GST returns on time every month to demonstrate consistent financial discipline.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: gst_filing_delay_days
features.label: GST filing delay
features.reason_risk: GST returns are filed about {value:.0f} days late on average — late filings accumulate penalties and signal cash-flow stress.
features.advice: Set calendar reminders and file GST returns at least 3 days before the due date.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: gstr1_3b_mismatch
features.label: GSTR-1 vs 3B mismatch
features.reason_risk: Sales reported in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B differ by {value:.0%} — mismatches suggest reconciliation gaps or under-reporting.
features.advice: Reconcile sales figures between GSTR-1 (outward supplies) and GSTR-3B before each filing.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: receivable_days
features.label: Receivable days
features.reason_risk: Customers take about {value:.0f} days to pay — longer than similar businesses, stretching your working capital.
features.advice: Send invoices promptly, follow up within 7 days of the due date, and offer early-payment incentives.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: upi_inflow_3m_avg
features.label: Average monthly UPI inflow (3m)
features.reason_risk: Recent digital inflows are low relative to the requested loan — suggests thin cashflow.

features.name: avg_bank_balance_3m
features.label: Average bank balance (3m)
features.reason_risk: Average bank balance over the last 3 months is low — limited buffer against payment shocks.

features.name: inflow_stability_cv
features.label: Inflow variability
features.reason_risk: Monthly inflows swing widely (coefficient of variation: {value:.2f}) — unpredictable cash makes repayment harder.

features.name: cheque_bounces_6m
features.label: Cheque bounces (6m)
features.reason_risk: {value:.0f} cheque(s) bounced in the last 6 months — each bounce signals a payment shortfall event.
features.advice: Maintain a payment buffer of at least one month's obligations in your bank account.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: utility_delay_days
features.label: Utility payment delay
features.reason_risk: Utility bills are paid about {value:.0f} days late — delayed utility payments indicate routine cash-flow pressure.
features.advice: Set up auto-pay or standing instructions for electricity, water and telecom bills.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: invoice_digitisation_share
features.label: Digitised invoices
features.reason_risk: Only {value:.0%} of invoices are digital and verifiable — paper invoices are harder to cross-check and raise data-quality risk.
features.advice: Migrate to e-invoicing under the GST system; digital records reduce reconciliation risk and improve credit visibility.
features._illustrative: Cost and timeline below are illustrative parameters under our documented assumptions.

features.name: inventory_days
features.label: Inventory days
features.reason_risk: Inventory sits for about {value:.0f} days before being sold — slow-moving stock ties up working capital.

features.name: payable_days
features.label: Payable days
features.reason_risk: Supplier credit period is only {value:.0f} days — short supplier terms compress the cash conversion cycle.

features.name: cash_conversion_days
features.label: Cash conversion cycle
features.reason_risk: Cash is tied up for about {value:.0f} days between paying suppliers and collecting from customers — longer cycles strain liquidity.

features.name: supplier_concentration
features.label: Supplier concentration
features.reason_risk: The business depends heavily on a few suppliers (HHI: {value:.2f}) — disruption to one supplier can stop operations.

features.name: customer_concentration
features.label: Customer concentration
features.reason_risk: The business depends heavily on a few customers (HHI: {value:.2f}) — losing one major customer would sharply cut revenue.

features.name: revenue_growth_3m
features.label: Revenue growth (3m)
features.reason_risk: Revenue has declined by {value:.0%} over the last 3 months — falling revenue reduces capacity to service debt.

features.name: sector
features.label: Sector
features.reason_risk: The {value} sector carries higher credit risk under current market conditions.

features.name: udyam_category
features.label: Udyam category
features.reason_risk: Enterprise size category: {value}.

features.name: requested_amount
features.label: Requested loan amount
features.reason_risk: The requested amount of ₹{value:,.0f} is high relative to verified inflows — increases repayment burden.
